item.title: Help Represent Coventry Township on the Portage Lakes Advisory Council
item.description: Do you care about the future of the Portage Lakes? Here's an opportunity to get involved! Coventry Township is seeking one resident to serve as the Township's representative on the Portage Lakes Advisory Council (PLAC). PLAC is a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to promoting the use, preservation, and conservation of the Portage Lakes ecosystem while enhancing public safety and recreational opportunities for the community. item.title: We're now a "Do Not Knock" Community!
item.description: Residents in Coventry Township can now sign up for the Do Not Knock registry! When you sign up, you’ll receive two window clings to place near your door, and your address will be added to the lists of homes and businesses that for-profit solicitors are not allowed to visit.
